held.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade deadly strikes as Zelenskyy prepares to meet Trump

Held under the high-impact corroboration and photography gates.

held.headline: UN Security Council reform debate intensifies as Erdogan targets veto and Russia defends it
held.reason: Reuters reports Russia supports adding permanent members while retaining veto rights, in response to President Erdogan's call to abolish permanent membership and veto power. The policy positions are material but this cycle did not complete independent corroboration from a second approved newsroom plus the required reusable image package. Held pending those gates.

audit.note: Fresh consequential international reporting available by the September 22 Asia/Manila cutoff was reviewed using the approved newsroom source policy. No candidate cleared all high-impact corroboration and reusable-photography requirements in this cycle, so no story is represented as published. The prior Worldwide cycle also records that the canonical production CMS/public-route publication action was unavailable after Supabase execute_sql permission denied; no evidence in this run established that this production blocker has been repaired.
